name: Caitlin Clark x Nike Kobe 5 Protro 'Coconut Milk Spruce'
story_html: The Caitlin Clark x Nike Kobe 5 Protro 'Coconut Milk Spruce' delivers a PE colorway of the classic silhouette. The upper is constructed from glossy synthetic leather in a subtle ivory finish with dark teal overlays and a color-matched Swoosh. A contrasting splash of crimson appears on the tongue, marked with Kobe Bryant's signature Sheath logo. This Protro edition features a lightweight Cushlon midsole with an articulated Zoom Air unit in the forefoot. A grippy rubber outsole reveals an exposed glass-based carbon fiber shank plate underfoot.
